name: actionpin
description: Local-first GitHub Actions workflow risk checker.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js scan fixtures/bad-workflows --format json --fail-on high --ignore-rule secrets.plaintext > /tmp/actionpin-smoke.json; test $? -eq 1; node dist/src/cli.js scan fixtures/good-workflows --out /tmp/actionpin-good.md --fail-on high

author: Roger Chappel
